note: Six ADTC profiler runs. The three 'cold' runs each followed a full WSL shutdown, which discards the VM page cache, so the 1.93 GB model is read from disk every time. The 'warm' runs reused a live VM and are recorded only to document why cold measurement is necessary: throughput climbs as the model becomes resident. benchmark/submission.json is cold3, the median cold run by throughput.

environment.why: Default WSL2 exposed 9.7 GB and ~3 GB of swap; a peak-RSS figure taken there could be absorbed by swap rather than failing the 7,168 MB ceiling.
